subject: Clarify evidence & retention scope for BYO/KMS + SSO mapping
messages:
From: LitmusHealth <security@litmushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Evidence retention & SSO mapping questions for BYO/KMS pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We walked the team through the BYO/KMS pilot proposal and a few follow-up items came up from security and procurement:

- For audit evidence: can you confirm whether keystore rotation events (who/when) and envelope metadata (key IDs, model version) are included in the standard audit export, or will that require a separate evidence package?
- Retention windows: procurement expects a clear matrix that maps evidence type -> retention SLA (e.g., auth logs 90 days, key escrow events 3 years). Can you share the current working matrix?
- SSO mappings: our IdP uses several custom attributes (department_code, contract_id). Will Redwood's SSO sync allow attribute mapping to the audit entries so we can slice logs by contract_id?

We're on a tight timeline for the pilot start (target: early Nov). Procurement also asked if there are any product-level blockers we should be aware of that would require exceptions or an alternate plan.

Attaching our internal evidence checklist for reference.

Thanks,
--
Marta Alvarez
Staff Security Engineer, LitmusHealth
security@litmushealth.com

Subject: Re: Evidence retention & SSO mapping questions for BYO/KMS pilot

Marta / LitmusSecurity team —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, then I'm assigning owners and next steps below:

- Keystore rotation & envelope metadata: currently rotation events (rotate requests, admin user) are recorded in the audit stream, but the envelope-level key ID + model version are only surfaced in the detailed evidence package we generate for SOC-style requests.
- Retention matrix: we have a draft; attaching an internal draft (retention_matrix_draft.pdf). It does not yet map custom IdP attributes into log slices.
- SSO attribute mapping: the platform supports SAML attribute passthrough for provisioning, but we do not currently enrich audit entries with arbitrary IdP attributes by default.

Owners / asks:
- Priyom (Infra/Product): can you confirm whether we can include envelope key metadata in the regular audit export within 2 sprints, or if that requires a feature?
- Grace (Optimize / Product Ops): please review the retention matrix and mark which rows need immediate policy text for procurement.
- Ben (Sales/CS): can you surface the procurement exception process to Litmus so they understand timing if we need a short-term carveout?

Next steps: I'll collate responses, then propose a minimal acceptance criteria list for the Nov pilot.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Evidence retention & SSO mapping questions for BYO/KMS pilot

On Tue, Sep 21, 2026 at 1:05 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Priyom (Infra/Product): can you confirm whether we can include envelope key metadata in the regular audit export within 2 sprints, or if that requires a feature?

Quick technical update:

- What exists today: audit stream captures rotation events with actor and timestamp. Envelope metadata (key_id, key_version, model_tag) lives alongside the object in the keystore service but is not currently emitted into the realtime audit export due to size concerns.
- Work required: emitting envelope metadata to the audit export is a small ingestion/transform change (add fields to the audit serializer) + a schema bump for downstream ETL. Estimated effort: 3 engineer-weeks + a short ETL rollout (non-blocking).
- Timeline: if we prioritize it, we can land a non-breaking export with the additional fields in ~3 weeks (2 sprints).

Questions for Litmus: which envelope fields are MUST-HAVE for pilot (key_id only vs full envelope)? If it's just key_id + model_tag, we can compress and include.

I'll prepare a short RFC and attach a sample JSON schema for review.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Engineer, Inference Infrastructure
priyom@redwood.com
From: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: LitmusHealth <security@litmushealth.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence retention & SSO mapping questions for BYO/KMS pilot

Thanks — I reviewed the draft retention matrix and added inline comments. Key product asks / recommendation:

- Minimal pilot scope (what we commit to now):
  * Auth logs (successful + failed logins): 90 days (standard)
  * Keystore rotation events (audit): 1 year in primary export, 3 years available as an evidence package on request
  * Envelope metadata (key_id + model_tag): include in export for pilot but mark as compressed/optional field

- SSO attribute mapping: for pilot, we can map one attribute (contract_id) into a log dimension via a small transform in the audit pipeline. Mapping department_code is lower priority. This requires an ETL config change rather than product-level work.

- Procurement ask: provide a one-page acceptance criteria doc (I'll draft) that lists what data will be present in the export vs what will be in the evidence package. That reduces the need for exceptions.

I'll attach the acceptance criteria one-pager and send to procurement this afternoon.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Product Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

All — thanks for the fast responses and concrete proposals. Summary / actions before EOD Mon: 

1) Priyom: please share the RFC + sample JSON schema by Monday EOD (priority: key_id + model_tag). We want the Litmus team to confirm the compressed schema is sufficient.
2) Grace: finalize the one-pager acceptance criteria and cc procurement (ACME) so they have language to sign against a pilot SLA. Attach the one-pager to the pilot kickoff invite.
3) Ben: please coordinate a 30-minute procurement sync with ACME/ Litmus procurement; target Tues 09/28. Litmus asked for an exception matrix only if we cannot include the key_id in export within 2 sprints.
4) Naomi (me): I'll update the pilot checklist and confirm the Nov start gating is based on schema signoff + acceptance doc.

If any of the owners think timelines need adjustment, flag immediately and we'll propose a scoped fallback.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
